recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下整片是單調的中型母細胞，核圓至不規則、染色質細緻、核仁不明顯、細胞質稀少，可見核分裂像，正常三系造血消失；型態符合淋巴母細胞白血病，B 系與 BCR::ABL1-like 需靠流式與分子檢查。
features: Packed, monotonous sheets of small-to-medium blasts replacing normal hematopoiesis
High N:C ratio with scant pale cytoplasm
Round to irregular, occasionally indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Scattered mitotic figures and rare apoptotic bodies; no maturing myeloid, erythroid or megakaryocytic elements in field
describe_en: High-power H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow replaced by monotonous sheets of small-to-medium blasts. The blasts have scant cytoplasm, round to irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and scattered mitotic figures are present. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by acute lymphoblastic leukemia; lineage assignment (B-lymphoblastic) and BCR::ABL1-like classification require flow cytometry and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: Blasts often have more cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, and are MPO/CD117-positive rather than TdT/CD19/PAX5-positive.
Cells are TdT-negative mature B cells with starry-sky pattern, near-100% Ki-67 and MYC rearrangement.
Cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and TdT-negative with CD5 expression.
Morphologically identical; distinguished by cytoplasmic CD3 positivity and lack of B-lineage markers.
